title: I made this solo game: Domingo — playable in the browser (feedback welcome)
author: cacapota
selftext:
Hi, I’m an indie developer and I just released Domingo, a small game I made solo.

You can play it directly in the browser, no download required:

https://eloyy.itch.io/domingo

This is a short, experimental project, focused more on experience and pacing than on complex systems. It’s not meant to be a commercial product or anything AAA-like; it’s a learning project and a space to test ideas.

I’m looking for honest feedback and direct criticism, especially regarding:

Core mechanics and game feel

Pacing and length

Clarity for the player

What works and what doesn’t

Any design or technical feedback is appreciated.

comments.author: oniris
comments.body:
Absolutely stunning!
I would love to know the tools you used in making it.

comments.author: DoctaRoboto
comments.body: Hey, the game looks cool. I was expecting some jumpscary AI slop fest. But it is a surreal and weird experience.
